QUOTE: "**The approval callback cannot deny.** `EngineCallbacks::on_tool_call` returns `void` (`engine_types.h:370`). In `check_approval` (`tool_executor.cpp:168-171`), any non-null callback sets `approved = true` after it fires."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states that the callback returns void and that approved is set to true unconditionally after it fires, so it cannot refuse.
